title: Exactly one archetype
statement: A declaration MUST select exactly one archetype.

title: No undeclared field
statement: A declaration MUST NOT carry a field that STEGO, the selected archetype or its components do not declare.

title: One document, no indirection
statement: A declaration MUST be one YAML document, and MUST NOT use anchors, aliases or merge keys.

title: Bounded input
statement: A declaration MUST NOT be larger than 4 MiB, and MUST NOT nest more than 128 levels deep.

title: Entity names are unique
statement: Every entity name MUST be unique within the declaration.

title: Field names are unique in their entity
statement: Every field name MUST be unique within its entity.

title: Constraints suit the type
statement: A field's constraints MUST suit the type the field declares.

title: Collection names are unique
statement: Every collection name MUST be unique within the declaration.

title: A collection reads a declared entity
statement: A collection MUST name an entity that the same declaration declares.

title: A binding names a declared collection and slot
statement: A slot binding MUST name a collection the declaration declares, and a slot that a component of the active component set declares.

title: One operator for each binding
statement: A slot binding MUST carry exactly one operator, which is gate, chain or fan-out.

title: A bound slot is invoked
statement: A slot binding MUST name a slot that a generator in the build invokes, so a binding cannot compile without ever running.

title: A setting matches its component schema
statement: A component setting MUST name a component of the active component set and a setting that component's schema declares, and its value MUST suit the declared type.

title: A default suits the type
statement: A field's default MUST suit the type the field declares.
